13. On transfer I appointment from one ex cadre post to another ex cadre post.If an employee on appointment or transfer to an ex cadre post had opted to draw pay in the scale of the ex cadre post, his pay in the second or subsequent ex cadre posts, will be fixed under FR 22 (I) (a) (1) or (a) (2), as the case may be, with reference to his pay in the parent cadre only and not with reference to his pay in the ex cadre post.
